# Dynamic badges

This directory holds JSON files consumed by [shields.io endpoint badges](https://shields.io/badges/endpoint-badge) in the project README.

These files are **generated by CI** (they should not be hand-edited), following the [shields endpoint schema](https://shields.io/badges/endpoint-badge):

- `tests.json` — number of passing tests from `cargo test --workspace`.
- `loc.json` — lines of code in the workspace.

Each file looks like:

```json
{ "schemaVersion": 1, "label": "tests", "message": "11 passing", "color": "brightgreen" }
```

Until a CI job writes them, the corresponding README badges will show as unavailable.
